summary: Full backend + frontend testing of VoiceBank prototype. Backend /api/parse-command validated for all 11 intent types via pytest (12/12 pass). Frontend end-to-end demo flow tested via Playwright: login (wrong+correct pw), mode select, dashboard (balance ₹25,430 + 9 action cards), text-command flows (balance/transactions/beneficiaries/notifications/help/cancel/go back), full Send Money PIN flow (wrong PIN + success + balance decrement to ₹24,930), Insufficient Balance failure path, Bill Payment (electricity) success, Mobile Recharge success, and accessibility (high-contrast toggle). Found and fixed one critical wiring bug in BankContext.

ui_bugs.issue: `announce` was defined in provider but NOT exposed via context value; SendMoneyScreen/BillPayScreen/RechargeScreen destructured `announce` from useBank() which returned undefined, causing 'announce is not a function' TypeError on Continue click in direct action-card flows (send-money, pay-bills, recharge). This blocked the entire Insufficient Balance flow and any payment initiated from action cards.

action_items: Verify the fix to /app/frontend/src/context/BankContext.jsx (added `announce` to exported context value). No further action strictly required.
critical_code_review_comments: BankContext.jsx exposed `speak/replay` but not `announce`, though downstream screens depended on `announce`. Consider spreading a single memoised object or exhaustive-deps lint to catch such misses.
Backend uses model id 'gpt-5.4-mini' — works via emergent LLM proxy today, but hardcoded model string is fragile; consider env var.

commandParser.js falls back to localParse only when server returns action==='unknown'. If server returns a wrong action (e.g. LLM misclassifies), local regex fallback is not tried — acceptable for demo.
No tests folder / no CORS_ORIGINS list issue observed. Everything else clean.
PIN screen text 'Demo payment PIN: 5678' is visible — intentional for demo but should be gated in production.

success_rate.frontend: 100% after fix (all demo-flow checks pass: login, mode, dashboard, text-commands, send-money w/ wrong+correct PIN, balance decrement, insufficient-balance failure, bill pay, recharge, beneficiaries, notifications, help, go back, cancel, contrast toggle)

test_credentials: App password 1234, Payment PIN 5678 (per problem statement; /app/memory/test_credentials.md not present).
seed_data_creation: None. All data is client-side mock (INITIAL_BALANCE ₹25,430, beneficiaries Rahul/Priya/Arun, INITIAL_TRANSACTIONS).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dashboard action-card testids: action-check-balance, action-transactions, action-send-money, action-pay-bills, action-recharge (NOT action-mobile-recharge), action-beneficiaries, action-notifications, action-settings, action-help. Beneficiary testids use ids b1/b2/b3 not names. Backend model is gpt-5.4-mini via emergent LLM key.
rca of the issue: SendMoneyScreen/BillPayScreen/RechargeScreen destructure `announce` from useBank(). BankContext.jsx defined `announce` locally with useCallback but never added it to the `value` object returned in `<BankContext.Provider value={value}>`. Reproduction: login 1234 -> Voice+Text -> click 'Send Money' card -> pick Rahul -> type 500 -> click Continue -> 'announce is not a function' uncaught runtime error (webpack overlay blocks further interaction). Fix: added `announce` to the exposed value object.
